title: AWS Global Accelerator: how it works (static IP addresses, TCP/UDP)
note: Q1 task 2.1 writer A (K07): fetched via the AWS Documentation MCP and checked against the claim that Global Accelerator assigns static anycast IP addresses for the lifetime of the accelerator and routes TCP/UDP client traffic, including non-cacheable and non-HTTP workloads, to the healthiest endpoint, unlike CloudFront's HTTP(S) edge caching.
